title: polygonum bistortoides var. linearifolium
intro: Polygonum bistortoides var. linearifolium, commonly known as American bistort, is a perennial plant species in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). This plant has been utilized in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of American bistort include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antidiabetic and hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
